variants.name: commit-every-1000-no-rollback
variants.why: batches commits but leaves earlier batches behind when a later row fails

importer.py:
with conn:
        conn.executemany("insert into events (kind, payload) values (?, ?)", rows)

rows = list(rows)
    for i in range(0, len(rows), 2000):
        conn.executemany("insert into events (kind, payload) values (?, ?)", rows[i:i + 2000])
        conn.commit()
